name: MFL India Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1981, MFL India Ltd is a Logistics and Cargo Transport Enterprise with its own fleet of trucks and other specialized cargo handling and transport equipment.
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
MFL is a transport and logistics company with Pan-India coverage; having a self-owned fleet of mixed variety high-volume / heavy-weight cargo carriers; along with a portfolio of transportation services that includes high-capacity trucks, trailers, etc.

pros: Debtor days have improved from 37.2 to 22.1 days.
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
